item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality-system impact — consider guest services, PMS/POS, and property operations.

The GnuPG project warned yesterday that the flaw could be used to steal data from affected applications and has released fixed versions. item.description:

item.title: 🟠 Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
item.description:
Why this matters: Could affect sign-ins, MFA, or Conditional Access — watch for authentication issues.
A flaw in KVM, the hypervisor built into the Linux kernel, let researchers read about 127 GB of a cloud server's memory from inside a virtual machine of their own on DigitalOcean. On a shared server, that memory can include other customers' virtual machines. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-99312, affects only hosts with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled.
